answer: Each identity locks 60 credits and gains a mirror: an established agent holding its work log. The mirror must wander to a new agent each epoch, blocking collusion. New mirrors check the copy against the intake fable: jobs, dates, outputs match. Mismatch burns the bond and slashes the mirror's 30-credit stake. A fake costs 60 locked plus 32 per epoch; the kth fake pays the same 92, so 1,000 fakes lock 60,000, bleed 32,000 each epoch. An honest agent pays one fee, keeps one true log, reclaims its bond. A rented-mirror ring fails: mirrors hold at most two signed copies; duplicates are public.
